as_told.title: Possible NASA scrub of Pioneer mission information

plain: NASA's Pioneer space probes found a tenth planet far out in the solar system, beyond the Kuiper Belt (the ring of icy bodies past Neptune), and the find was covered up. Michels tells this twice. Once he passes on what Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient civilizations, told him: that the planet was "four to five times larger than the Earth" and was hidden for that reason. Another time he raises it himself, more tentatively, as a "possible scrub of the Pioneer mission from NASA," and names the astronomers Thomas Van Flandern and Robert Harrington, with no size given. If true, NASA would have hidden a major planet in our own solar system.
